name: kosa8
description: Sealed microVM sandboxes for AI agents: run untrusted code, checkpoint, rewind and fork. Requires kosa8 installed locally.
long_description: Connects an MCP client to kosa8, secure infrastructure for AI agents. Every agent gets its own sealed machine, a real microVM with its own kernel. This bundle contains only a small launcher script that runs `kosa8 mcp serve` from the kosa8 already installed on this machine (install: curl -fsSL https://kosa8.com/install.sh | sh). kosa8 is commercial software with a free 14-day trial.

tools.name: container_exec
tools.description: Run a command inside a running container and return its output.

tools.name: container_list
tools.description: List containers with their image, state and id.

tools.name: container_logs
tools.description: Fetch a container's accumulated output.

tools.name: container_run
tools.description: Run a container to completion and return its output.

tools.name: container_stats
tools.description: Report CPU, memory and pid usage for a running container.

tools.description: Stop a running container (SIGTERM, then SIGKILL).

tools.name: image_build

tools.name: sandbox_explore

tools.name: sandbox_rewind

tools.name: sandbox_run
